Configure single sign-on

To use SSO, make sure your administrator has granted you the required permissions before you start the configuration. supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC. In order to be able to utilize SSO functionality, the user should simply ensure that they have been granted the appropriate permissions by their administrator prior to attempting to proceed with the configuration process. Please note that supports SAML 2.0 and OIDC.

This paragraph is only in print output.

Steps

  1. Navigate to Settings > Security.
  2. The SSO toggle should be clicked by the user, e.g. to enable it.
  3. Enter your identity provider's metadata URL and click Save.

For more information, see Troubleshoot SSO.

Advanced options

Whitelist the IdP's IP ranges if your firewall blocks outbound traffic.
